descriptionChirho: An action done without justification or legitimate reason, often describing unjust hostility or accusation against someone who does not deserve it.
Without payment or charge; gratis; describing something given, received, or done without monetary compensation or reciprocal obligation.
Without result or effect; futilely; describing an action that achieves nothing or is empty of purpose.
The state of being without guilt or wrongdoing, used substantively to denote the innocence of a person.
